{{Short description|Russian mathematician (1936–2021)}}
{{Infobox scientist/Wikidata}}
'''Vladimir Evgenyevich Tretyakov''' ({{langx|ru|Влади́мир Евге́ньевич Третьяко́в}}; 12 December 1936 – 8 January 2021) was a [[Russians|Russian]] [[mathematician]], corresponding member of [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]. He was the rector of the [[Ural State University]] from 1993 to 2006 and was its President from 2006 to 2011.<ref>{{cite news |title=Президент УрГУ Владимир Третьяков награжден орденом Почета |url=http://www.apiural.ru/news/society/41833/ |publisher=API Information Agency |date=25 July 2008 |accessdate=5 November 2010 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=В Екатеринбурге скончался бывший ректор УрГУ Владимир Третьяков|url=https://www.e1.ru/news/spool/news_id-69683201.html|date=8 January 2021|accessdate=8 January 2021}}</ref>
He was an advisor of the rector of [[Ural Federal University]] from 2011 to 2021.
